purpose: Short real-world SRT cases that reproduce historically expensive directing and production failures before a full-length project is attempted.

selection_policy.smoke: Run at least one case that overlaps the changed failure class.
selection_policy.director_change: Run all cases whose risks overlap the directing change.
selection_policy.production_gate_change: Run all cases plus control-plane regression tests.
selection_policy.release_candidate: Run the complete case library; visual claims still require rendered review rather than JSON-only success.

must_demonstrate: Audience-facing implementation never falls back to planning text.
The argumentative turn changes the visible relationship, not only the title copy.
Repeated named actors/evidence receive source-timed attention rather than generic card rotation.
A failed visual implementation triggers self-repair instead of asking the user whether it is acceptable.

Core scenes are authored visual-first: footage, spatial relationships, data geometry or object-state change carries the argument; UI containers only support that argument rather than becoming the default scene.
Rate, oil, valuation, turnover and asset-selection responsibilities do not collapse into one repeated card shell.
Background is treated as context while the foreground explains the causal/selection logic.
The handoff into AI is visually motivated by the argument rather than a template change.
Three institutions and target prices are aligned and individually addressable when spoken.
The market-share evidence tests the preceding narrative rather than appearing as another report card.
Expansion beyond the representative section uses the same canonical production path and quality standard.
The two competing explanations are represented as a real comparison/branch rather than two text panels.
Price cuts, incentives and order evidence change the visible reasoning state when introduced.
Motion is tied to information progress rather than decorative card entrance.

global_assertions: No known quality regression may be transferred to the user as an acceptance question.
Technical pass, static frame review and continuous visual review remain separate evidence classes.
Representative and expansion work use the canonical production entry and active content revision.
A repeated P0/P1 failure escalates to mechanism-level repair instead of another broad patch revision.
Core explanatory scenes remain visual-first and do not silently regress to UI-first or container-first authoring.
